caption: The video captures a high-angle close-up of a white snowball resting on a dark, glossy surface that mirrors its surroundings. The polished panel reflects a house with light-colored siding and two windows, plus bare tree branches against a deep blue sky. A thin line runs across the upper frame, separating the reflected sky from the body of the panel. The snowball shows a crystalline, granular texture, its rounded form catching the daylight and casting a soft mirrored halo beneath it. Scattered water spots and small rings of residue dot the dark expanse around the ball, especially toward the right. Throughout the visible portion, the ball holds its position on the surface without rolling, sliding, or visibly shrinking, though the framing drifts subtly as the trim line and reflected house shift slightly against the ball and the fixed spots. The lighting stays even, so the clip reads as a largely still moment rather than an unfolding action.
relations: A snowball resting in contact with the glossy panel tends to hold its position unless disturbed.
The panel's mirror reflection of the house and sky shifts together as the framing drifts.
The thin trim line separates the reflected sky from the panel body across the upper frame.
Scattered water spots remain fixed on the dark surface while the ball stays in place.
